text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Royce and Royce got 
injured, so I brought her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, how careless of me... To make such 
a blunder...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's a blessing in disguise that 
the injury wasn't serious.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We haven't even finished half of today's 
routine yet. Standing around daydreaming 
will only waste more time, won't it?
choice_data_list:
No, let's play it safe and take the day 
off
No, let's play it safe and rest today.
...Just make sure not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We haven't even finished half of today's 
routine yet. Standing around daydreaming 
will only waste more time, won't it?
choice_data_list:
No, let's play it safe and take the day 
off
No, let's play it safe and rest today.
...Just make sure not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Why? Even though I'm telling you I'm fine, 
I'd like an explanation that makes sense.
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, you'll lose even more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Neglecting the initial response 
only magnifies the losses. Addressing it 
now will incur a lower cost overall.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If my body can't move, I'll just make up 
for it with my brain. Get the data ready 
for the next race. I'm going to borrow 
your wisdom to the fullest!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I know my boundaries when it 
comes to that sort of thing!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it hurts so much that I can't 
move it any further. I'd really appreciate 
a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the injury worsened, and she 
had to rest quietly for a while.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hah, whew... Fufu, looks like I'm 
completely fine after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's make up for the lost time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Royce and Royce overcame her 
injury and made a splendid return to 
training.
